selection: Numerically first 30 eligible speakers, first numeric utterance per speaker; mono 16 kHz, >=10 s; no algorithm score selection.
scenes: Ten consecutive speaker triples per corpus subset; each speaker and recording appears once.
statistical_unit: 10 speaker-disjoint scenes per subset; combine three predefined subsets for 30 scenes.
usage: Unscored holdout candidate. Freeze algorithm configuration and clustered statistical protocol before evaluating; no B1 acceptance claim.
cache_policy: Fetch one bounded official archive at a time. After MD5/SHA and extraction verification, discard only newly fetched archive cache; preserve selected FLAC, metadata, manifests and all historical artifacts.
sha256_pin_origin: Pinned after official MD5 verification; pre-acquisition selection policy preserved separately.
